newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Unrequited Bunds still yearn for 103.52.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Unrequited Bunds still yearn for 103.52.

text.p: September Bund futures traded on LIFFE will once again aspire to break above the contract high at 103.52, technical analysts said on Friday.
However, if they fail at that hurdle in the short term, it will increase expectations that a double top is forming, after the market rose to 103.51 on Thursday and then backed off.

"There was a lot of profit taking and technical selling yesterday, and it left a very bearish formation which will lead to a pullback," said Celaya. "But the non-farm payrolls may be the spark Bunds need to get through the contract high."
September Bunds were down 0.03 at 103.00 by 0700 GMT.
September Bund futures were unchanged at 103.03 by 0720 GMT.
Celaya said the market would face resistance in the 103.20/21 area, where there is congestion from hourly charts. Above there, then further hourly congestion at 103.30 comes in.
"If it can get above that, then everything's fine until the contract high," he said.
Technical analysts at a European bank in London said in a research note the bottom of Thursday's value area was in the same place as Tuesday's. Thursday's low was 102.90.
"The support shown there has to be confirmed by an end of week close above 103.00," they said in the note.
Celaya said a close below 102.90 would be worrisome, but the market would need to decline below the July 25 low at 102.63 to confirm a double top was in place.
Below 102.90, the European bank analysts pegged support at 102.83 and 102.63.
December Euromarks were down two basis points at 96.52.
